notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 1.2.250908
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Vincent now looks at the chicken in the tutorial.
[*] Elevator sound effects added
[*] Look at the player for some dialogue
[*] Restrict walk path so you can’t walk over the chicken.
[*] Elevator doors not touching the floor (small gap at the bottom) fixed
[*] Using coffee on plants no longer loops its animation and gets added to your inventory.
[*] Saving/Loading working correctly in the office scene.
[*] Extended Fog and Fixed Statue Layer order in Outside Bar Scene.
[*] Added Dialogue to Hammer pickup. 
[*] Janet Right Facing Mouth Animations fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 1.2.250813
notes.content:
Fixed bug where if you use the mirror on Janet before trying to walk past it locks the mirror option off.
Fixed Photocopier Animation audio and dramatisation. 

Known Bugs:
Using coffee on plant loops its animation
Es and Ernest are too big in front of the bar.
Joe not in the right layer order
Need to animate paper opening.
Saving and Loading needs a major overhaul :(

notes.title: Crushing of evil bugs June 27th
notes.content:
Fixed some sprite ordering problems in Laundromat and Mortuary. 

Changed the Soul Candle puzzle to prevent having 2 soul candles.

Fixed some cutscene logic triggers.

notes.title: May 18 Update... bugs must be crushed.
notes.content: Fixed Vamp Guard Dialogue in Dungeon, also trying to fix random walk off on save loading.

notes.title: Hotfix and Bugs
notes.content:
As requested, added a way to turn off the CRT post processing, I will add this to the setting menu eventially but for now you can just press 'P' to to turn it on and off.

Fixed bug where after using the candle in the bathroom you can't go back in and it hangs on a black screen.

Fixed Nav Mesh so vincent can't walk on top of the chicken in the tutorial. 

Removed look option on books as it does nothing.

Omg there are so many bugs. I'm going to go on a bug smooshing rampage. These naughty bugs keep sneaking in and sucking away all the fun.

notes.title: New Render Pipeline and bug fixes
notes.content:
Changed to more optimised 2D Render Pipeline.
Updated 2D lights in all scenes
Added all highlights to hotspots
Fixed particle materials for URP2D
Added Audio Sources to character not talking.

notes.title: Post Processing and Dungeon Fix
notes.content:
Added Post Processing to make vincent look more retro including CRT screen emulation and screen grain.

Slowed down Dungeon Guard to make sure people have time to interact with the light hotspot.

General Bug fixes and all that.
